risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~19% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.037), which favours a robust combination.
